newsitem.title: CANADA: Placer Dome surrenders Marcopper interest.
newsitem.headline: Placer Dome surrenders Marcopper interest.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc said on Monday it will surrender its 40 percent interest in Marcopper Mining Corp back to Marcopper.

The Vancouver-based company said it would remain involved in the Marcopper copper mine until environmental problems were resolved, but would no longer have a financial interest in the property or the Philippines-based company.
"We're withdrawing from any business role in Marcopper. We will have no further interest," spokesman Hugh Leggatt said in a phone interview.

Placer Dome has already taken a US$40 million charge against earnings in the second quarter to cover financial oblibations to Marcopper. The amount includes $15 million to repair and clean up the mine.
The mine has been closed since March when waste from a storage reservoir leaked into a nearby river on Marinduque Island.
Placer Dome said the flow of tailings from the drainiage tunnel had been stopped and the company was working on a permanent plug.
